turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Most orders ship out from our Toronto, Canada warehouse within 1 to 2 business days.

Once your order ships, you will receive your tracking number by email or SMS. Tracking updates can take up to 3 business days to appear after shipment 🙂

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Standard delivery typically takes 3 to 7 business days for orders within the US and Canada. For international orders, delivery usually takes 15 to 20 business days from the shipment date 🙂

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
Please keep in mind that tracking information can take up to 3 business days to update after shipment. If your tracking still shows no updates after a few days or goes without movement for over a week, please reach back out to us so we can investigate further 🙂

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
Unfortunately, once an order has been processed or shipped, we are unable to reroute it or change the shipping address. Address changes can only be made within the initial 30-minute window after placing a regular order (or 3 business days for custom items) through our Edit Order Portal 🙂
